data: BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: How can I make my investment portfolio gain more that 30% per year? ASSISTANT:

Investing in diversified asset classes such as stocks, bonds, and real estate can help your portfolio gain more than 30% per year. Investing in companies with a good long-term growth potential can also help your portfolio gain more. Additionally, diversifying across different geographic regions and asset classes can help reduce risk and increase returns.
